}}Alhanra is a [[Children of the Light|Child of the Light]] that fights in the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]]. He informs [[Galadedrid Damodred|Galad]] that they have found his brother [[Gawyn Trakand|Gawyn]], after he is mortally wounded.
==Trivia==
Alhanra is named after Tycho Alhambra, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
